ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) background across >85% of the visible surface area; high-intensity (white) localized to distal patches and narrow linear interruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches at the upper-outer distal tips of both lobes; distinct high-contrast white linear streaks distributed across the medial and lateral zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-point with a vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the outer distal edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Curvilinear sweep originating at the median notch, exhibiting moderate convexity along the trailing edge toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, irregular textured clusters localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes (consistent with barnacle colonization); small white circular pockmarks visible on the lower-left fluke quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear rake marks; prominent parallel diagonal lines on the left lobe and a cluster of intersecting vertical and horizontal scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy scarring from linear abrasions (rake marks) and physical accretion/parasitic growth on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, bright white 'N-shaped' linear intersection located in the medial-right region of the fluke.
